additions.distinctness_review: The city identifies the Veterans Memorial property separately from Google Southlands on Bunge Avenue and the Edged development on College Road. Google’s 2012 letter identifies its first and second Council Bluffs facilities separately.

locator.identity_review: The county records Tetra LLC at 1430 Veterans Memorial Highway, on the parcel containing the federal address point. The city identifies Tetra LLC as Google and names the existing data center on that street.
locator.method: National Address Database property address point, checked against the county parcel and city records.
locator.precision: Campus property address point. Its published placement within the parcel is unspecified.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The federal address point has unknown placement and no published numerical uncertainty.

status.summary: On September 14, Council Bluffs city staff identified Google’s Veterans Memorial Highway property as an existing large-scale data center. They identified Southlands separately.

additions.successor_review: The September 2026 city presentation describes the original Google property as an existing data center. No expansion or new opening is inferred.

additions.distinctness_review: LT DC1 at J. Tiškevičiaus g. 72 is distinct from LT DC2 at T. Ševčenkos g. 16J and LT DC3 at A. Juozapavičiaus g. 13 in the operator’s directory. The nearest previous mapped site, Delska EU North Vilnius LT DC2, is 11.7 km away.

locator.identity_review: The operator and facility registration both identify LT DC1 at number 72. The municipal register has separate civic points for number 72 and number 72A; the selected point has no letter suffix.
locator.method: Vilnius municipal address point for street 1473127, number 72
locator.precision: Municipal civic address point for the commercial property.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The city supplies no horizontal uncertainty in metres for this civic point.

additions.distinctness_review: The 207 snapshot contains no Liechtenstein project. The operator identifies its Schaan and Eschen facilities separately. Its carrier also distinguishes SupraNet Schaan from LKW Schaan.

locator.identity_review: The operator advertises its data-centre services with Im alten Riet 121, 9494 Schaan, names the Schaan facility on its server-housing page, and GAS&COM lists that facility separately. The national register matches the named property address.
